performance-architecture|scalar/SIMD performance architecture|hot-path profiling scalar reference benchmarks and hostkit-backed platform acceleration hooks|benchmark thresholds plus scalar equivalence tests|closed|Jpeglib.Internal.Colors exposes compiler-vectorized RGB-to-YCbCr gray-alpha and CMYK/YCCK row input kernels used by encoder plane filling plus YCbCr-to-RGB-family direct RGB gray gray-alpha CMYK and YCCK row output kernels used by direct full-size grayscale two-component three-component four-component lossless 4:4:4 DCT direct-output three-component subsampled DCT and direct-output four-component CMYK/YCCK subsampled DCT decode row output; encoder chroma downsampling for 4:4:4 4:2:2 4:2:0 and 4:1:1 plus encoder full-block sample loading use compiler-vectorized image-block loops; Jpeglib.Capabilities advertises SIMD_Acceleration; jpeglib_simd_matrix uses hostkit and checks bit-exact scalar equivalence across every public input output and downsampling layout while reporting the compiler-vectorized backend; jpeglib_performance_matrix reports the active acceleration profile and emits JSON-style baseline progressive and arithmetic encode/decode threshold evidence
